<translate>
<!--T:4-->
The '''Movies Saga''' retells the DBZ movies, from Garlic Jr. to Hirudegarn. Unlike the other sagas of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas|story mode]], it runs alongside the main story: its first quest opens after ''Defeat Raditz'' ([[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] #1), and each later movie only opens once you have reached the matching point of the main story. Its fights take you across [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]].
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:5-->
The Broly, Bio-Broly and Hirudegarn movies unlock the '''Legendary Forms''' skill one level at a time, and Super Janemba rewards the [[Special:MyLanguage/Dimension Sword|Dimension Sword]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Notes == <!--T:153-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:154-->
* The three Hirudegarn quests open after ''Super 17 Returns'' (GT Saga #30) or after ''Majin Duu Appears'' (Daima Saga #11), whichever you complete first.
* Broly transforms mid-fight, switching to his next form with new stats.
* On Hard, the last enemy of most movies uses the Expert AI tier: Lord Slug (Giant), Cooler (Final Form), Metal Cooler Core, Super Android 13, Broly (Legendary Super Saiyan), Bojack (Full Power), Bio-Broly (Giant), Super Janemba and Hirudegarn (Final Form).
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Turles|Turles]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler Core|Metal Cooler Core]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Janemba|Janemba]] also roam the world as [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|World Bosses]]. The Janemba world boss can also drop the Dimension Sword.
* Quest 35 is a single fight against [[Special:MyLanguage/Pikkon|Pikkon]]. The full [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]] is a separate [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|tournament]].
* Quest 17, ''Big Gete Star'', pits you against 10 [[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Robot|Gete Robots]] in the Ajissa Plains of Namek.
</translate>
